title: Article 360 — Provisions as to financial emergency

content.overview: Article 360 empowers the President to proclaim a Financial Emergency if satisfied that a situation has arisen whereby the financial stability or credit of India or any part of its territory is threatened. The Proclamation must be approved by each House of Parliament (within two months) and may be revoked. During a Financial Emergency, the Union may give directions to States to observe canons of financial propriety, reduce salaries and allowances of State employees (including High Court Judges), and reserve Money Bills and other financial Bills for the President’s consideration after they are passed by the State Legislature. Union salaries (including Supreme Court Judges) may also be reduced as provided.
content.glance: Financial Emergency: threat to financial stability or credit of India or any part. Parliamentary approval. Union may direct States on financial propriety, salary cuts, and reservation of Money/financial Bills.
content.study:
Article 360 Financial Emergency:
**Ground:** financial stability or credit of India or any part of its territory threatened.
**Approval:** each House of Parliament (within two months); continues until revoked.
**Effects:** Union directions to States on financial propriety; reduction of salaries/allowances of persons serving in connection with State affairs (including HC Judges); reservation of Money Bills and other financial Bills for Presidential consideration after State Legislature passage; similar reduction possible for Union (including SC Judges) as provided.

Examination: ground; 2-month approval; directions and salary cuts; Money Bill reservation; rarely used historically.

sections.heading: Key elements
sections.body:
1. Ground: threat to financial stability or credit of India or any part.
2. Presidential Proclamation; approval by each House within 2 months.
3. Union directions to States on financial propriety; salary reductions; reservation of Money/financial Bills for President.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Financial Emergency under Article 360.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 360, if the President is satisfied that a situation has arisen whereby the financial stability or credit of India or of any part of its territory is threatened, the President may by Proclamation declare a Financial Emergency. The Proclamation must be approved by each House of Parliament and may be revoked. During its operation, the Union may give directions to any State to observe canons of financial propriety, require reduction of salaries and allowances of State employees including High Court Judges, and require that Money Bills and other financial Bills be reserved for the President’s consideration after being passed by the State Legislature.

examTips: Financial stability/credit; 2-month approval; directions, salary cuts, Money Bill reservation.

keyTakeaways: Art 360: Financial Emergency — stability/credit threat; Union financial directions.
